notes: Lookaround (Zhang et al., 2023): d copies of the network start from a common point, each takes k optimizer steps on its own augmentation of the same mini-batches (around step), and their weights are averaged into the next common point (average step). The augmentations are the paper's fine-tuning set: horizontal flip, RandAugment and AutoAugment (ImageNet policy). One network at every budget. Base recipe as in every baseline otherwise (Adam per copy, plateau schedule and checkpoint of the best epoch on source validation, both read from the averaged network). Paths are relative to the repository root.
